metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Rami Ejleh that keep a human in the loop as the machine speeds up — installable from the ramiejleh/DefyAtrophy GitHub repo.

plugins.name: interactive-pr-review
plugins.description: Interactively review GitHub PRs (comments only) — Claude fetches the PR, writes a holistic overview, groups the diff into logical chunks with neutral descriptions, a 'things worth confirming' list, and inline insight bubbles explaining the code, presents them in a review UI with a sidebar and IDE-highlighted diffs (full diff per group), and posts your line- and file-level comments back to GitHub in one click.

plugins.name: review-gate
plugins.description: Blocks Claude's write tools once it has generated more code than you have reviewed. A hook measures unreviewed change per project — from the git working tree, so shell writes and subagents count, and the count survives across conversations. Crossing the strict (150) / medium (400) / loose (1000) threshold queues a gate that arms at the end of the turn, so you review a finished feature rather than half of one; it then plants marker comments in your source that only you can delete, blocks Claude's editing tools and shell while armed, and asks you a question about the changes. Both stages always apply and there is no skip command.
